question: Which employee has handled the most orders?

question: Which customers have never placed an order?

question: Which employee sold the most, and which sold the least?
reference_sql: WITH t AS (SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS employee, ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM Employees e JOIN Orders o ON o.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID JOIN "Order Details" od ON od.OrderID = o.OrderID GROUP BY e.EmployeeID) SELECT 'highest' AS label, h.employee, h.revenue FROM (SELECT * FROM t ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1) AS h UNION ALL SELECT 'lowest', l.employee, l.revenue FROM (SELECT * FROM t ORDER BY revenue ASC LIMIT 1) AS l
note: evaluate.py compares whole rows, so the label wording counts; the model may write most and least. Compare names and totals by hand.
